title: A Collaborative Content Moderation Framework for Toxicity Detection based on Multitask Neural Networks and Conformal Estimates of Annotation Disagreement
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a multitask learning framework for content moderation and toxicity detection using conformal prediction. While toxicity detection is an application within safety and ethics, the paper evaluates performance and calibration metrics (like F1 and ECE) rather than benchmarking religious values, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning systems.
